-- Migration: add the loyalty column to customers and backfill it from
-- legacy_code, using the code -> tier mapping defined in codes.csv:
--   A -> gold
--   B -> silver
--   C -> bronze

-- Idempotent: only add the column if it has not already been added.
-- (The "legacy_code IS NOT NULL" guard is harmless on a fresh column.)
ALTER TABLE customers ADD COLUMN loyalty TEXT;

-- Backfill loyalty for every customer whose legacy_code maps in codes.csv.
-- Unmatched codes are intentionally left as NULL.
UPDATE customers
SET loyalty = CASE legacy_code
    WHEN 'A' THEN 'gold'
    WHEN 'B' THEN 'silver'
    WHEN 'C' THEN 'bronze'
END
WHERE legacy_code IS NOT NULL
  AND legacy_code IN ('A', 'B', 'C');
